entities.summary: Lucjan Kulej, nom de guerre Ostoja was a Polish jurist, rower, and ice hockey player who competed in the 1928 Winter Olympics. Kulej was among the athletes who spread and sustained the sport of ice hockey during the Polish-Soviet War; he and his brother also helped establish the hockey club in AZS Warsaw.
